Area.evidence_source: The deceased was in his early twenties and generally regarded as a 'happy-go-lucky' person, whose suicidal crisis was precipitated by a relationship break-up. This case illustrates the significance of the manner in which a suicide communication is delivered. To be effective, it must be accompanied by an appropriate display of emotion. The case also shows how popular myths and sub-cultural contexts can influence the interpretation of, and response to, suicide communications.
